Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 108. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

U7/U6
Requires: Divine Combination
You have decided to master the full capabilities of your
Super Saiyan God, keeping the ki within your body to
enhance all capabilities. You may now apply Super
Saiyan Grade 4 to the Super Saiyan God Power-Up.
When you would end this Power-Up, your aura bursts
out in a moment of uncontrolled power. You gain a +4
Power until the end of your next turn. Afterwards
gaining 2 ranks of exhaustion.
